checks.message: Provisional geometry is explicitly labelled and never presented as an official or precise boundary.
All three key areas are present, non-overlapping, inside the site and explicitly provisional.
The land-use layer is generated as a complete sequential partition with shared edges and no intentional gaps or overlaps.
Known spatial metrics are recomputed in EPSG:4548 from the submitted design geometry; unknown controls remain null with reasons.
Repository evidence and seven first-party international case sources are separated by permitted use and limitation.
Twelve scenarios include four bounded industry tests plus opt-in, privacy, human-review and exit conditions.
Proposal, sources, assumptions, figures, HTML and self-check disclose provisional precision and mandatory regeneration.
Offline visual uses local figures and inline CSS only, with no remote resources, scripts, forms, APIs or trackers.
A3 and A0 PDFs have non-zero pages; all 14 A3 pages and all 7 A0 pages were rendered with Poppler and visually inspected before submission.
Every required chapter links readable design judgment to standards, depth, geometry, metrics, sources and data gaps.
No external map tiles, photographs, logos, portraits or proprietary visual assets are included; generated graphics use disclosed source data and OFL font tooling.
